title: Choosing a holiday
instructions: Bir çift tatil yeri seçiyor. Uzun bir diyalog; reddedilen fikirleri ve kararı takip et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Where do you want to go this summer?

script.speaker: b
script.text: I want to go to the beach. What about Spain?

script.speaker: a
script.text: Spain is very hot in August. What about the mountains in Austria?

script.speaker: b
script.text: I don't like walking a lot. What about Greece? There are beaches and it's not very expensive.

script.speaker: a
script.text: I only have one week of holiday.

script.speaker: b
script.text: OK, seven days. Shall we go by plane?

script.speaker: a
script.text: Yes, it takes three hours. I can look for tickets tonight.

questions.prompt: Why doesn't Paul want to go to Spain?
questions.evidence: Spain is very hot in August.

questions.prompt: Why doesn't Kate want to go to Austria?
options: She doesn't like walking a lot.
questions.evidence: I don't like walking a lot.

questions.feedback: Paul'un bir haftalık izni var; yedi gün.
